meta.title: Order Activity records a bid rejected
gaps: Assert the new activity entry identifies the exact rejecting user and date/time.
Assert that no earlier activity entries are missing and that the complete activity history is chronologically ordered.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Assert the new activity entry identifies the exact rejecting user and date/time.; Assert that no earlier activity entries are missing and that the complete activity history is chronologically ordered.

steps.note: Open an existing event with bids so a bid can be rejected without creating an unrelated test event.
Navigate to the stage Responses view where the bid rejection control is available.
Reject the available bid as required by the scenario.
Open the stage Order Activity drawer after the rejection.
Assert that the Order Activity drawer opened.
Assert that the activity history contains a bid-rejected entry.
